decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 2 - All advertisements displays, and any site used for the display of advertisements shall be maintained in a clean and tidy condition to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 3 - Any structure or hoarding erected or used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a safe condition.
Condition : 4 - Where any advertisement is required under these regulations to be removed, the removal shall be carried out to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant planning permission.

Condition : 6 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions, the scale, design and location of the signage is appropriate to the business park and does not harm the visual amenity of the area or traffic safety in accordance with adopted Unitary Development Plan Policies ENV.1.1 (All New Development), ENV-B.1.4 (Advertisements) and Policy S.4.3 (Advertisements).
description: Erection of various illuminated and non illuminated signage to business park.
